{{Top}}
'''Obsidian''' was a material. It could be found on [[Bassadro]], [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]], [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] and [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. Sometimes, a [[fry-rock]] was composed of obsidian, and the material was used in part of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|armor]], the [[Shadow Throne]], and also to make [[Obsidian Lance|obsidian lances]] and [[obsidian sword]]s. [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]] also had an obsidian [[Talisman (artifact)|talisman]], which apparently had lucky properties.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ObsidianLance.png|thumb|right|325px|An obsidian-forged Mustafarian lance]]
[[Wikipedia:Obsidian|Obsidian]] is a smooth, dark rock that is made out of hardened lava.

It is also the sharpest substance in the known universe in contemporary science.
